Question 13

Given the Cartesian equation 2x+y−2z−4=0 of the plane Π, find an equation of Π in the form (r−p)⋅n=0.

a
(r−⟨0,0,2⟩)⋅⟨1,0,−1⟩=0
b
(r−⟨0,0,2⟩)⋅⟨2,1,−2⟩=0

d
(r−⟨0,0,−2⟩)⋅⟨2,0,−2⟩=0
